by
  intro A K _ _ _ _ _ _ f a b hab hb h
  have hb' : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors A := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hb
  have hu := IsFractionRing.num_den_unique (A := A) (algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K b) a ⟨b, hb'⟩ hab (IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div ⟨b, hb'⟩)
  exact ⟨hu.1.symm.dvd.trans (num_dvd_of_is_root h), hu.2.symm.dvd.trans (den_dvd_of_is_root h)⟩
target_source: ∀ (A K : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (f : Polynomial A) (a b : A), IsRelPrime a b → b ≠ 0 → Polynomial.aeval (algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K b) f = 0 → a ∣ f.coeff 0 ∧ b ∣ f.leadingCoeff
